title: Facebook Has 3 Billion Users — And Most Local Business Pages Get Almost None of Them

segments.text: Facebook has 3 billion users — and most local business pages get almost none of them.

segments.narration: Facebook still has over 3 billion monthly active users. It remains the most-used social platform for local business discovery. The opportunity is real — the problem is most pages operate without a system.

segments.text: 6x More Reach — Daily vs Weekly Posting
segments.narration: Pages that post daily get six times more organic reach per post than pages that post weekly. The algorithm rewards consistency, not occasional great content.
Facebook Lead Ads convert at around 12 percent on average, compared to just 2.4 percent for a standard landing page. The form is built into the ad — no separate website needed.

segments.title: Relative Organic Reach by Posting Frequency
segments.narration: Pages posting daily index at 100 percent reach. Drop to three or four times a week and you're at 60. Post less than weekly and you're down to 15. The algorithm decides based on your consistency, not your content quality alone.
See exactly how to set up the scheduling system and automation — link in comments.
